determinism.evidence: linux_premerge comparisons named baseline-* (repeated runs of one backend)
determinism.finding: Nullkiller seeds a std::mt19937 from std::random_device in HeroChainCalculationTask::execute (AI/Nullkiller/Pathfinding/AINodeStorage.cpp), so its hero-chain choices are not reproducible from the game seed on either backend. Repeated cold runs and repeated embedded runs of the same scenario diverge at the same frame with the same two variants; cross-backend rows are identical whenever both runs took the same variant. Opponent logic and RNG are unchanged.

notes: v7 and v8 (adventure-capabilities-v1) real games on both seats and both backends, including the capability level-up maps; every ended row was replayed independently and every policy row's choices were reconstructed.
Rows whose histories diverge between backends have equal outcomes; Nullkiller's unseeded hero-chain search (see determinism) produces the same divergence between repeated runs of one backend.
